verses.40:44: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ

meaning: The root فوض (fwD) describes a state of equality, dispersion, or mixture, often implying a lack of leadership or order.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
